assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is indicated
This 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to support the diagnosis and management of the patient's cardiac arrhythmias as documented in the clinical indication
